description: Declarative MCP tool definitions for the Instagram Graph API. Each tool maps to endpoints in openapi.yaml. Implemented by mcp/server.py (requires: pip install mcp requests).

tools.description: Get the IG user profile (id, username, account_type, counts).
tools.name: ig_get_profile

tools.description: List media on the IG account with cursor pagination.
tools.name: ig_list_media

tools.description: Create a media container (step 1 of publishing). Photo: image_url. Reel/video: media_type REELS + video_url. Returns container id.
tools.name: ig_create_container

tools.description: Poll a container until FINISHED (videos). Returns final status_code.
tools.name: ig_wait_container

tools.description: Publish a container (step 2). Returns published media id.
tools.name: ig_publish_container

tools.description: Read publishing quota (quota_usage vs quota_total per 24h).
tools.name: ig_publishing_quota

tools.description: Account insights for metric list + period + Unix since/until.
tools.name: ig_account_insights

tools.description: Media insights for one media id + metric list.
tools.name: ig_media_insights

tools.description: List comments on a media id.
tools.name: ig_list_comments

tools.description: Reply to a comment id with a message. Returns reply id.
tools.name: ig_reply_comment

tools.description: Send an Instagram DM to an IGSID from webhooks (24h window, RESPONSE).
tools.name: ig_send_message

tools.description: Resolve a hashtag name to a hashtag id.
tools.name: ig_hashtag_search

tools.description: Recent media for a hashtag id.
tools.name: ig_hashtag_recent
